note: Summary of the per-check evidence records referenced by the acceptance ledgers; raw logs/screenshots stay in the git-ignored verification/ tree (hashes listed).

actions: Launch 'UI4ME Desktop Workspace' from the Start Menu (Recently added)
N01.expected: Hosted identity, icon, taskbar, no extra console
N01.observed: Launched by explorer.exe; backend python.exe child of the host; backend conhost has no window; taskbar 'U' icon

actions: Probe started in a session job; second launch from the Start Menu 'UI4ME Host Reference' entry
N02.expected: Second launch forwarded to the running instance
N02.observed: Running backend logged 'Second launch:' (app.activated); still one host and one backend

actions: Probe second window: MoveWindow resize, maximize, restore, minimize, restore, WM_CLOSE
N03.expected: Window operations and asynchronous close decision
N03.observed: All operations reflected; WM_CLOSE -> backend 'Close accepted w2'

actions: Probe <-> Notepad copy/paste with real Ctrl+C/V; renderer Notes <-> Notepad with Unicode; 2.2 MB clipboard text
N04.expected: Bidirectional clipboard with another local app; oversized rejected
N04.observed: Probe->Notepad 'Probe to Notepad', Notepad->probe, Notepad->UI4ME Unicode text exact; 2.2 MB paste rejected ('Data transfer exceeds 1 MiB')

actions: Probe F3/F4/F5 with Escape; F3 select Unicode file; F4 save typed name; F5 select folder; F7 from second window; WM_CLOSE parent with dialog open; Ctrl+Q from second window with save dialog open
N05.observed: Dialogs owned by the probe window with owner disabled; results correct; F7 'client cancellation requested'; parent close and quit closed the dialogs and exited

actions: Microsoft Pinyin in probe: preedit, commit, Escape cancel, selection replacement, Tab during composition
N06.expected: Real IME composition, Unicode, caret; no hang on focus change
N06.observed: Commit 你好/世界 correct; Tab during composition left the window responsive. A GUI deadlock on focus change during composition was found and fixed (vendored winit-win32 patch); before/after evidence in m5
limitations: Probe font lacks CJK glyphs (boxes); the HTML renderer uses system fallback

actions: UIA tree of the probe; Tab focus; UIA InvokePattern on Copy
N07.expected: UIA tree, focus and an action
N07.observed: Tab focus Copy/Paste/Open file; Invoke(Copy) placed the editor text on the clipboard

actions: RDP reconnect at /scale-desktop:150 with the app open; pointer and IME checks; reconnect at 100%
N08.expected: DPI change re-render, correct pointer/IME, restored
N08.observed: App re-rendered at 150%; physical clicks hit Name/Notes; Pinyin committed; back at 100% with document state intact
limitations: At 150% the window was clamped to the 1600x1000 work area, so it returned smaller at 100%

actions: Native fault fixtures (freeze-close, freeze-quit, crash-after-ready with failure-UI Quit, freeze-quit --duration 0 with typing and Ctrl+Shift+Q); renderer --hold-callback and --crash-after-ready
N09.expected: Responsive host-local UI and failure UI
N09.observed: All fixtures PASS (pending one BLOCKED by design after observation); typing while decision withheld; Ctrl+Shift+Q exits; failure surface with working Quit

actions: run_faults managed-tree and managed-tree --kill-host with Windows Job Object containment
N10.expected: Descendants cleaned after quit and forced host kill
N10.observed: Both PASS, containment 'Windows Job Object (backend assigned during creation)', 0 survivors

actions: UIA tree; ValuePattern.SetValue; TogglePattern; RangeValuePattern; InvokePattern(Add row); TextPattern range Select/GetSelection; NVDA 2026.3.1 portable keyboard journey with IO log
